name: v2_forward_1C
description: Forward DFN PINN, Chen2020 (LG M50), 5 A (1C) discharge from SOC 1 with a 30 s tanh current ramp, 0-3000 s. Reference used only for evaluation. fourier_t=4 adds sin/cos(2 pi k t) time features (k=1..4), which removed the systematic 2.6 mV voltage bias of the plain (2t-1, 2g-1) inputs (docs/V2_RESULTS.md 2e). collector_bc=hard makes the zero-flux / zero-current conditions at the two collectors exact (docs/V2_RESULTS.md 7); the soft version violated them at the graphite-staging current peaks.
